tasks.check: deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc --noEmit && deno check server/index.ts scripts/setup.ts scripts/dev.ts scripts/deploy-functions.ts
tasks.build: deno task check && deno run -A npm:vite build
tasks.lint: deno lint && deno run -A npm:@biomejs/biome lint .
tasks.test:integration: deno task build && deno run -A scripts/test-stack.ts
tasks.deploy:functions: deno task check && deno run -A scripts/deploy-functions.ts
